# ona_skill (List Resource)

Lists importable organization-level Ona skills. Template/skill hybrids are excluded because `ona_skill` cannot manage them.

For product context, see [Skills](https://ona.com/docs/ona/skills). List resources are used by Terraform Query and require Terraform CLI `>= 1.14`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `command` (String) Exact slash-command name to match.
- `command_prefix` (String) Slash-command prefix to match.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive search across skill name, description, and command.
